question: What would we see of the outside world from inside a black hole?
answer: Inside a black hole, the outside world would look distorted. The black hole's huge mass and density bend space-time, so light from the Milky Way is bent by that gravity and every image reaches you stretched and warped. As you slide toward the black hole, the sky itself looks bent.
move: Extreme gravity bends light, so the sky itself looks bent.

web.label: A view of the night sky in which the Milky Way is bent, stretched and warped into curves. The page asks what the outside world would look like from inside a black hole. Slide to fall toward the black hole and watch the sky bend.
